source: DUO rekenhulp terugbetalen, https://duo.nl/particulier/rekenhulp-studiefinanciering.jsp#/nl/terugbetalen/ — expected values reproduced by hand from the calculator's own client-side algorithm in https://duo.nl/apps/rekenhulp-sf/assets/index.js (sha256 aaebd0251632eab07e028cb73d3d600a834a6896a9a57c4a13c64a552a5e6212), NOT from an interactive run; no screenshot yet (follow-up)
derivation: See README.md in this folder. Monthly rate i = (1 + rate)^(1/12) − 1; each month interest = balance × i and payment = balance × i / (1 − (1 + i)^−k) over the k months left (balance / k at 0%); total paid = sum of payments; rekenhulp restschuld without income = 0. Values rounded to cents.
